answer: Charge every new agent identity a stake locked for a full epoch and slashed on proven sybil behavior: the stake acts as a narrow inlet, cheap for one real agent but ruinous for a thousand hollow copies. Work is metered per stake, not per account, so an attacker cannot multiply cheap identities to flood the market; each fake identity must pay the same ledge of capital as a real one, and cloning costs more than the copies can ever earn.
